thread:
olivia: quick heads-up: rebuilding base images today, keystore operator needs a new unwrap path for envelope:v2. want to avoid canary outage. who can pick up RBAC and audit bits?

alex: I can. what's the minimal permission set?

olivia: operator currently had `cloudkms.decrypt` on the symmetric key. new flow uses an asymmetric signer -> requires `cloudkms.asymmetricDecrypt` on the attestation key resource.

mike: Are we rotating the signer now? if so the operator needs ephemeral access to the new key during the rollout.

olivia: yes, rotate to `attest-key-v2`. prefer short-lived grant not broad binding.

jana: can we use Workload Identity + token exchange instead of IAM binding? reduces blast radius.

alex: proposal: create `sa-keystore-unwrapper@redwood-prod`, map via Workload Identity, issue STS token when pod has an annotation. operator will exchange pod JWT for a short-lived GCP token.

luke-sre: good. two ops asks: how will unwraps appear in audit logs? and what's fallback if unwrap fails in canary?

olivia: audit: structured entries with actor, key, envelope_version, image_digest. SOC wants 365d retention, might be costy. fallback: canary should serve prebuilt fallback image if unwrap fails.

sec-bot: vuln-scan note: rebuild will bump libseccomp and openssl. run private scanner before roll.

alex: RBAC snippet I'll test (gated rollout):

```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.asymmetricDecrypter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:sa-keystore-unwrapper@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    # we'll not give a permanent binding; CI will apply a short-window condition or use STS
```

mike: Role conditions don't inspect pod annotations. STS + signed JWT approach is safer. I'll take the token-exchange impl.

jana: I'll run a vuln pass on the rebuilt image and post results. block rotation on any high/critical findings.

luke-sre: I'll add a healthprobe that checks unwrap success within 45s and flip the helm chart to use fallback registry on failure. planning canary at 18:00 PT.

olivia: if you see logs like `google.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt.permissionDenied` ping me immediately and pause rollout.

alex: I'll open a PR with the SA+WI mapping and the audit log patch. sample audit event I'll add to the Splunk parsers: 

```json
{"ts":"2026-03-23T17:02:12Z","actor":"sa-keystore-unwrapper@redwood-prod","key_id":"projects/rebuild-keystore/locations/global/keyRings/base/cryptoKeys/attest-key-v2","envelope_version":"v2","image_digest":"sha256:deadbeef","status":"success"}
```

mike: assigned step 2 (token-exchange). will update with PR.

jana: posting scanner results in 15m.

olivia: great. after canary is green i'll publish a short runbook snippet and retention note for SOC. :thumbsup:
